decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay utilizing a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to clear the way for powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. Thoughtseize and Duress disrupt opponent's strategies while cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Liliana of the Veil provide additional disruption and value. The mana base is designed to support a consistent curve of powerful threats, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Misery's Shadow provide additional ways to close out the game quickly.

The main focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to maximize green mana production and devotion in order to play powerful green cards quickly and efficiently. By utilizing mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic along with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, this deck aims to ramp up to big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cityscape Leveler offer additional resilience and win conditions against a variety of opponents.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, utilizing Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa to generate massive amounts of green devotion. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Kahm, the Great Creator provide additional mana advantage and card draw. Meanwhile, the aggressive creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn put pressure on the opponent while Storm the Festival and Lair of the Hydra provide additional threats and utility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with its efficient ramp and powerful green devotion cards.

The main concept of this deck is centered around utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which involves using Parhelion II and Greasefang, Okiba Boss to create a powerful synergy. The deck includes cards that support this combo such as Raffine's Informant, Esika's Chariot, and Witherbloom Command. Additionally, the deck includes cards for control and disruption like Thoughtseize, Liliana of the Veil, and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship. The mana base is optimized to support the combo and provide consistency in casting the necessary spells. Overall, the strategy focuses on executing the combo efficiently while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for powerful plays such as casting Emergent Ultimatum or Behold the Beyond. The deck also includes various mana acceleration cards like Sylvan Scrying and Arboreal Grazer to help ramp up to its big combo turns. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of control elements like Dark Petition and Bala Ged Recovery, as well as card draw spells like Pore Over the Pages to dig for key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while also generating huge amounts of green devotion through cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Cavalier of Thorns. This devotion allows for powerful plays with cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Old-Growth Troll, supported by powerful spells like Storm the Festival and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and powerful spells early in the game, creating a strong aggro presence on the battlefield.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, removal spells, and powerful finishers. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Sinister Sabotage to control the opponent's hand and plays, while using powerful creatures like Torrential Gearhulk and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game. The deck also has some graveyard interaction with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Ertai Resurrected, as well as land destruction with Field of Ruin. Overall, the goal is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through control and disruption.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Lotus Field with various untap effects such as Thespian's Stage, Hidden Strings, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It includes spells like Pore Over the Pages and Dark Petition to help find combo pieces and win conditions like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck also includes lands like Bala Ged Recovery and Lair of the Hydra for recursion and additional utility. Overall, the key strategy is to ramp quickly and win through powerful spells and combos.

The main concept of this deck revolves around ramping up mana quickly with creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as utilizing Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate more mana. The goal is to play powerful green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to overwhelm the opponent with big threats. Cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to create a high-powered board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck is focused on taking advantage of sacrificing creatures for value. By using cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to deal damage while generating additional resources. With cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute, the deck can disrupt the opponent's board and gain advantage through sacrificing creatures. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. Overall, this aggressive deck aims to overwhelm opponents through a combination of sacrificing creatures and aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on casting spells quickly and efficiently to enable the reanimation of Arclight Phoenix, a powerful flying threat. The deck includes cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability, as well as card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle to help dig for more Phoenixes. Thing in the Ice and Young Pyromancer provide additional threats, while Counterspells like Spell Pierce help protect your Phoenixes once they hit the battlefield. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and repeatable threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap and efficient spells to quickly fill the graveyard with spells, enabling the Arclight Phoenix to return to the battlefield repeatedly. By combining card draw, burn spells, and graveyard recursion, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. The inclusion of cards like Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise provide additional late-game power, while cards like Spikefield Hazard and Lightning Axe help deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes some counter magic and land manipulation for added versatility.

The deck focuses on assembling the Lotus Field combo using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Thespian's Stage to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This allows for powerful plays such as casting Omniscience or Emergent Ultimatum. Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands provide untap effects to further fuel the combo. The deck includes additional utility cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Lair of the Hydra for extra flexibility. Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City protect key spells from countermagic, ensuring the combo can go off smoothly.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through counterspells and removal spells, while also generating card advantage and card selection with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The addition of Shark Typhoon provides a win condition and defensive creature, while the manlands like Hall of Storm Giants provide additional threats. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind them out with powerful control elements while staying ahead on resources. The sideboard can be customized to handle specific matchups and threats efficiently.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Traverse the Ulvenwald to find key pieces quickly. Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command provide disruption and protection. Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship offer additional threats. Raffine's Informant and Scrapwork Mutt help with card advantage and flexibility. The deck aims to control the board, generate value from the combo pieces, and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on using Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to create a loop of sacrificing and bringing back creatures for value. Mayhem Devil punishes opponents for each sacrifice made, while Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push provide removal options. The deck also includes some aggressive threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bloodtithe Harvester. The mana base includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant to support the aggressive game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of sacrifice synergies and aggressive threats.
